stdout:
AppShell

name:        AppShell
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AppShell
description: AppShell is the page shell for an application. It provides slots for top navigation, side navigation, banners, and main content. Use it as the root wrapper for every page. It handles responsive mobile navigation and skip-to-content automatically. Configure side nav collapse on SideNav with its collapsible prop.

AspectRatio

name:        AspectRatio
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AspectRatio
description: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes. Use it for media containers like videos, images, thumbnails, or any content that needs consistent proportions. It takes its width from the container and derives its height from the ratio, so it needs an ancestor with a definite width.

Avatar

name:        Avatar
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Avatar
description: Avatar displays a user or entity's profile picture with automatic fallback to initials or a default icon. Use it alongside user information to visually represent people, teams, or entities throughout the interface.

name:        AvatarGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AvatarGroup
description: AvatarGroup 以重叠排列方式显示多个头像，并可选择显示溢出指示器。使用组合式 API：直接传入 Avatar 子元素，每个头像可携带自己的属性。

name:        AvatarGroupOverflow
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AvatarGroup
description: AvatarGroupOverflow 显示在 AvatarGroup 末尾，用来汇总未单独展示的成员。适用于只展示少量头像但仍需要显示隐藏数量的场景。

name:        AvatarStatusDot
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Avatar
description: 尺寸感知的状态指示点，从上下文中读取头像尺寸并等比缩放。每个变体将颜色与独特形状（实心、圆环、横杠）配对，确保状态不仅靠颜色传达（WCAG 1.4.1）。

Badge

name:        Badge
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Badge
description: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance. Use it sparingly: only when a value represents a distinct state (Active, Failed) or a grouping tag (Engineering, Design). Most metadata (dates, durations, counts, descriptions) should be plain description text, not badges.

Banner

name:        Banner
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Banner
description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section. Use it for form errors, system updates, maintenance notices, or success confirmations that the user needs to see until they act on it.

Blockquote

name:        Blockquote
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Blockquote
description: 带有行首边框和次要文本颜色的引用块。用于突出显示引用内容、推荐语或摘录。边框和内边距使用逻辑属性，因此在从右到左的语言环境中会移到右侧。

BottomSheet

name:        BottomSheet
import:      @astryxdesign/core/BottomSheet
description: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport. For a multi-step flow, give each step its own sheet and one state value that names the open step (see Replacing a sheet); open a second sheet over the first when a step should stay visible beneath it.

Stacking. Every sheet keeps its own isOpen. Open a sheet while another scrim sheet is open and it stacks on top: the sheet beneath stays mounted with its scroll position and inputs, recedes behind the new one (the nearest covered sheet shrinks to 0.96 and lifts 8px, deeper ones to 0.92 and 16px), and is blocked from pointer, keyboard, and assistive technology by the top sheet's modal dialog. The sheets can be siblings, live in separate components, sit inside another sheet's content, or sit inside a BottomSheetSwitcher step; a whole switcher is one level, and switching its step in place does not change its position. Nothing moves in the DOM: each sheet's dialog stays where it is written, and no wrapper component is needed.

Order is open order. The top sheet is the one presented most recently that is still open; a sheet that closes and reopens comes back on top. When several sheets open in one update (a deep link into a flow), there is no open order between them, so tree order decides: a sheet below the sheets rendered in its content, siblings in the order they are written. That order is right in the first painted frame.

One scrim. Only the bottom sheet's backdrop dims the page; the backdrops of the sheets above it are transparent, so a stack never darkens per level. The dim holds steady while sheets push and pop, and if the bottom sheet closes while sheets remain above it, the next sheet's backdrop takes over in the same frame.

Dismissal. Escape, a tap on the scrim, a downward swipe, and a platform close request (Android back, a close watcher) reach only the top sheet, through that sheet's own onOpenChange, and that sheet's purpose applies: required blocks all of them, form blocks the scrim and the swipe. Nothing closes a whole stack at once; set every sheet closed in one update when a flow is done and they leave together.

Closing a covered sheet from code. Sheets rendered inside the closing sheet's content are part of it: they are presented only while it is open and leave with it. Their isOpen stays yours, as with a Dialog rendered in a closed Dialog: nothing is written to it, and a nested sheet that is still open when its host reopens is presented again, on top. Set it closed yourself when the flow is done. Sheets above the closing sheet that are not in its content stay open and keep their order; the closing sheet slides out from beneath them, and if it owned the scrim, the sheet above takes it over.

Replacing a sheet. Close the top sheet and open another in the same update (one state value that names the open step does this) and the new sheet replaces it instead of stacking on it: the new sheet rises above the one it replaces; if the replaced sheet is taller it moves down to meet the new sheet's top edge at the same time; the replaced sheet fades only after both motions finish, and is inert and hidden from assistive technology from the start. The scrim holds steady throughout, with no dip; focus moves into the new sheet; and when the flow closes, focus returns to the element that opened its first sheet, whichever sheet closed last. This is the handoff the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher ran between its steps; a multi-step flow needs no switcher: give each step its own BottomSheet and one state value. A replace happens only when exactly one sheet closes and one opens in the update, the closing sheet was the top sheet of its stack, and the move was made from inside it (the control last pressed, or with no recent press the focused element, was in the closing sheet, as a step's own Continue or Back button is); a covered sheet closing while a sheet opens, a close and an open in different updates, or a close and an open driven from a control outside the closing sheet (two unrelated owners acting at once) keep the ordinary push and pop motion and their own focus return. A replace over an open stack runs one level up and leaves the sheets beneath covered. Non-modal sheets (hasScrim={false}) replace each other the same way, with no scrim: they are hosted in the browser top layer as manual popovers, so the entering step orders above the retained one with no page-level z-index, and toasts raised before or while the sheet is open stay above it. Below the Popover API support floor (Tier 2 in the browser support guide) the sheet falls back to show() in page stacking order: usable, but with no promise over later page content. A non-modal sheet returns focus to its opener on close only while focus is still inside it; focus taken elsewhere on the live page stays there.

Focus. Opening a sheet, modal or not, focuses its data-autofocus field (a TextInput with hasAutoFocus) in every browser. Without one, focus goes wherever the engine's native dialog focusing steps land: the panel in Chromium, the first focusable control in Firefox. A step entering as a replacement also focuses a data-autofocus descendant first, so a flow that opens on a field keeps the keyboard on it. Closing the top sheet returns focus into the sheet it reveals: to the control that opened it when that control is still there, otherwise to the revealed sheet's panel. When the last sheet closes, the standalone rules apply: finalFocusRef, else the element that opened the sheet, with a focus ring only after keyboard input. When every sheet of a stack closes in one update, focus returns once, to the bottom sheet's finalFocusRef or opener, after the last dialog has closed.

Caveats. A Dialog, AlertDialog, or Popover opened from a sheet paints above the sheet and does not make it recede; a sheet opened from inside that Dialog paints above the Dialog and stacks over the sheet beneath. Sheets with hasScrim={false} stay out of the stack entirely (they replace each other, but never stack, recede, or take the scrim). A sheet React hides (a suspended Suspense boundary, Activity mode="hidden") leaves the stack and closes its dialog; when it is shown again it is presented again, on top. Only sheets rendered in the same document stack; a sheet inside an iframe is its own stack.

name:        BottomSheetSwitcher
import:      @astryxdesign/core/BottomSheet
description: Deprecated: write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step. Closing the top sheet and opening the next in the same update, from a control inside the open step, runs the same replace handoff (see BottomSheet, Replacing a sheet), with no sheetId and no switcher; a step changed from a control outside the flow (a page control, or code after focus left the step) closes and opens with ordinary push and pop motion. BottomSheetSwitcher keeps working until a future minor release removes it: a flow used on its own behaves as released (with three fixes: a toast raised from a step renders above the flow and can be pressed, under reduced motion its steps follow the reduced-motion rule, and a step with a hasAutoFocus field opens on that field in every browser), and a flow stacked with other sheets is one level of the stack (it recedes and is blocked when covered, shares the one scrim, and stands down from dismissal while covered). Modal and hasScrim={false} flows migrate the same way. Set activeSheet to a nested BottomSheet's sheetId to open or switch steps, and to null to close.

Stacking. A scrim flow is one level in the stack of open sheets (see BottomSheet, Stacking). Open it while a standalone sheet is open and the flow sits on top of that sheet, which recedes and is blocked; open a standalone sheet while the flow is open, from a step's content or from anywhere else, and that sheet sits on top while the whole flow recedes as one. Switching the step in place never changes the flow's position. Escape, the scrim, a swipe, and a platform close request reach only the top level: the flow's onActiveSheetChange(null) when the flow is on top, the standalone sheet's onOpenChange(false) when that sheet is. A standalone sheet rendered inside a step's content is presented only while that step is the active one: it leaves when the flow switches step or closes, its isOpen stays yours, and it is presented again, on top, if the step returns while it is still open. Only the bottom level's backdrop dims the page. A no-scrim flow stays out of the stack.

Breadcrumbs

name:        BreadcrumbItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Breadcrumbs
description: BreadcrumbItem represents one destination, action, current location, or sibling-menu trigger inside a Breadcrumbs trail.

name:        Breadcrumbs
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Breadcrumbs
description: Breadcrumbs show a trail of links from the root to the current page. Use them at the top of detail pages, settings panels, or anywhere the user needs to see where they are and navigate back up.

Button

name:        Button
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Button
description: Button triggers an action when clicked. Use it for form submissions, confirmations, navigation, or any interaction that needs a clear call to action.

name:        ButtonGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ButtonGroup
description: ButtonGroup 将相关操作连接成一个控件。当多个按钮表示对同一对象的相关操作时使用，如复制/剪切/粘贴，或撤销/重做。

name:        IconButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/IconButton
description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text. Use IconButton in toolbars, table rows, and compact UI where space is tight and the icon is universally understood.

name:        ToggleButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ToggleButton
description: ToggleButton switches between selected and unselected states to represent a persistent on/off choice. Use it standalone for binary actions like bold, mute, or favorite, or inside a ToggleButtonGroup for single-select or multi-select toolbar controls.

name:        ToggleButtonGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ToggleButton
description: 将切换按钮分组，支持单选或多选行为。通过 type 判别联合类型实现类型安全。在触摸呈现下（主要指针为粗指针时），按下时分组像菜单一样跟踪按压：按下一个切换按钮并滑过其他按钮，高亮随之移动。只有松开时所在的按钮会切换，在分组外松开则不切换任何按钮。使用手指时，每个按钮的触控目标向 44 px 扩展，最多到与相邻按钮间距的一半，按钮本身不变大。

Calendar

name:        Calendar
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use it in booking flows, scheduling UIs, date filters, or anywhere the user needs to see surrounding dates for context.

Card

name:        Card
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Card
description: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently. Cards are NOT the default layout tool. Most content groups don't need a container at all; spacing and alignment create visual grouping naturally. Only reach for a Card when items need clear interaction boundaries or visual comparison in a grid.

name:        ClickableCard
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ClickableCard
description: An interactive card for navigation or action targets. Nested interactive elements work independently.

name:        SelectableCard
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SelectableCard
description: A card that toggles between selected and unselected states with an accent border. For navigation use ClickableCard.

Carousel

name:        Carousel
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Carousel
description: Carousel 在项目超出可用宽度时将一行项目水平滚动。适用于卡片网格、图片画廊、产品列表，或任何希望无需占据整页即可浏览的项目集合。

Chat

name:        ChatComposer
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 聊天编写器布局外壳。排列命名插槽（附件、标题栏、输入、页脚、发送），带有页面圆角容器和同心内圆角。

name:        ChatComposerDrawer
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 位于聊天输入上方的可折叠抽屉面板。传入 ChatComposer 的 `drawer` 插槽，用于显示附件、上下文标签或预览内容。提供 `count` 时启用折叠切换。

name:        ChatComposerInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 聊天编写器的富文本输入。支持触发菜单（输入 @ 或 / 打开 typeahead）、内联标记徽章、ArrowUp/Down 消息历史回溯、粘贴/拖放文件处理，并在 iOS 上将字体大小保持至少 16px 以避免输入缩放。当需要普通文本区域以外的功能时，传入 ChatComposer 的 input 插槽。

name:        ChatDictationButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer. It pairs with useChatDictation to show a microphone icon when idle and animated frequency bars when listening. Place it in the sendActions slot of ChatComposer.

name:        ChatLayout
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 完整聊天界面的布局外壳。消息在页面中自然流动，编写器固定在底部，带有毛玻璃效果。通过 density 属性控制密度。在可视视口会随软键盘缩小的浏览器中，编写器停在键盘上方，停留在最新消息的对话保持在最新消息。在 Android 上的 Chrome 中，编写器随 Gboard 的滑动同步移动。在 iOS 上的 Safari（浏览器中和添加到主屏幕的网页应用）和 Android 上的 Firefox 中，编写器会在浏览器报告键盘后移到键盘上方。在触摸屏上的顶层页面中，进入编写器文本的每种方式（轻点、键盘的上一项和下一项按钮、Tab、输入框的 focus()）都会聚焦它而不滚动页面；使用鼠标或在 iframe 中时沿用浏览器自身的聚焦行为。如果页面设置了 interactive-widget=resizes-content，Android 上的 Chrome 会自行为键盘缩小页面，编写器停在键盘上方而不移动（参见浏览器支持指南）。

name:        ChatLayoutScrollButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 可组合的滚动到底部按钮。可见时淡入，提供标签时展开。

name:        ChatMessage
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 发送者上下文包装器，根据发送者角色处理头像、名称、元数据和对齐方式。

name:        ChatMessageBubble
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 样式化的气泡容器，从父上下文读取发送者信息进行自动样式化。支持 name/metadata 插槽、多气泡分组和透明变体。

name:        ChatMessageList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 消息展示容器，支持密度上下文和无限滚动。自动滚动由 ChatLayout 管理。

name:        ChatMessageMetadata
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 可组合的消息元数据行。渲染时间戳、页脚内容和发送状态。用户消息方向反转。

name:        ChatSendButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 编写器的圆形发送/停止切换按钮。默认从 ChatComposerContext 读取状态，在 ChatComposer 内自动工作。所有上下文值均可通过 props 覆盖以用于独立使用。

name:        ChatSystemMessage
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 居中的系统消息，用于日期分隔、成员变更和状态通知等非发送者内容。没有头像、对齐或气泡。使用 divider 变体做时间分隔，default 做内联状态更新。

name:        ChatTokenizedText
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: 渲染带有标记模式的文本，将匹配的模式替换为内联标记内容。在 ChatMessageBubble 内使用，将 @提及、#标签或 /命令显示为样式化内容。没有非空匹配标记时以纯文本渲染。

name:        ChatToolCalls
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Chat
description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.

Checkbox

name:        CheckboxInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CheckboxInput
description: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value. Use it for settings like "Enable notifications", terms acceptance, or opt-in choices. For multiple checkboxes in a group, use CheckboxList instead.

name:        CheckboxList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CheckboxList
description: CheckboxList shows a small group of checkboxes so users can turn several options on or off at once. Place it in settings pages, filter panels, or forms where every choice should be visible without scrolling. For a single standalone checkbox (like "I agree to the terms"), use CheckboxInput instead. If only one option can be picked, use RadioList. If the list is long enough to need searching or scrolling, use MultiSelector instead.

name:        CheckboxListItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CheckboxList
description: 单个复选框选项，包含标签、描述和尾部内容插槽。可在集合模式（位于带 value 数组的 CheckboxList 内）或独立模式（位于 List 内，或位于不带 value 的 CheckboxList 内，例如"全选"选项）下使用。在触摸屏上，可切换的行是一个整体的按压目标：手指按在标签、描述或复选框本身上，行与其复选框会一起显示按下状态。主指针为精细指针时，复选框保留自己的按下效果。

Citation

name:        Citation
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Citation
description: Citations display inline references to external sources. Use them to attribute information within AI-generated responses, articles, or anywhere provenance and source links are needed.

Code

name:        Code
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Code
description: Code marks short inline references such as function names, variables, file paths, and command-line flags. Use CodeBlock for standalone or multi-line snippets.

CodeBlock

name:        CodeBlock
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CodeBlock
description: CodeBlock displays syntax-highlighted code snippets with optional line numbers, copy button, and collapsible sections. Use CodeBlock for fenced multi-line code and Code for inline code within prose.

Collapsible

name:        Collapsible
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Collapsible
description: Collapsible hides and reveals content behind a trigger button. Use it in settings panels, FAQ pages, or detail views to keep the page scannable while letting users drill into sections they care about. Wrap multiple collapsibles in CollapsibleGroup for accordion behavior.

name:        CollapsibleGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Collapsible
description: 协调多个 Collapsible 实例，使同一时间只有一个（single 模式）或任意数量（multiple 模式）可以展开。除非启用 dividers，否则不渲染包裹 DOM 元素。

CommandPalette

name:        CommandPalette
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: CommandPalette is a searchable dialog for quick access to commands, navigation, and actions. Use it as a keyboard-driven launcher powered by SearchSource for filtering and selection.

name:        CommandPaletteEmpty
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 结果区域的空状态展示。当搜索没有结果，或没有查询且 bootstrap() 未返回任何内容时，由 CommandPalette 自动渲染。

name:        CommandPaletteFooter
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 显示键盘导航提示的页脚。未提供子元素时渲染默认方向键/Enter/Escape 提示。

name:        CommandPaletteGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 带标题标签的视觉分组。放置在 CommandPaletteList 内。

name:        CommandPaletteInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 搜索输入插槽。挂载时自动聚焦。在 CommandPalette 内使用时连接到上下文。

name:        CommandPaletteItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 命令面板结果列表中的一个选项。CommandPalette 上下文提供选择、高亮、标识和关闭行为。

name:        CommandPaletteList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/CommandPalette
description: 可滚动的结果容器。独立使用时，以及在 CommandPalette 中存在可选结果时，作为 listbox 渲染。

ContextMenu

name:        ContextMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ContextMenu
description: 右键点击时在光标位置出现的上下文菜单。用于为特定元素或区域提供上下文操作，而不使 UI 杂乱。

DateInput

name:        DateInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DateInput
description: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover. Use it for scheduling, deadlines, booking dates, or any form field that needs a specific calendar date.

name:        DateRangeInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DateRangeInput
description: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover. Use it for filtering data by time period, report generation, analytics dashboards, and booking flows.

name:        DateTimeInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DateTimeInput
description: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field. With presentation="adaptive-native" (the default), mouse/trackpad devices use Astryx typed fields and popovers, while coarse-pointer devices use browser/OS date and time controls in the same two-segment field. presentation="native" uses both native controls on every pointer; presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" keeps Astryx's own surfaces - pointer fields on fine pointers and the coordinated Date/Time bottom sheet on coarse pointers; "popover" and "bottom-sheet" force one Astryx surface on every pointer. The closed segments stay side by side when at least 400px is available and wrap into full-width rows below 400px, independent of viewport width. Use it for scheduling, event creation, deadline setting, or any form field that needs a specific datetime.

Dialog

name:        AlertDialog
import:      @astryxdesign/core/AlertDialog
description: AlertDialog asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before it happens. Use it for things like deleting content, revoking access, or discarding unsaved changes.

It implements the WAI-ARIA APG [Alert Dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/alertdialog/): `role="alertdialog"`, a title linked by `aria-labelledby`, a consequence description linked by `aria-describedby`, focus moved into the dialog on open and returned to the trigger on close, and no dismissal by clicking outside. Escape cancels.

AlertDialog passes its requested width through to Dialog, which clamps the surface to the container and dynamic viewport with token gutters. Generic Dialog footers should wrap, but Dialog does not own action semantics or order; consumer composition controls that. AlertDialog owns its confirmation semantics: above 640px, actions render horizontally and may move onto another row; at 640px and below, the destructive action appears above Cancel and both buttons fill the footer width. Button labels retain their standard single-line behavior. The breakpoint follows available width, not pointer or hover capability. The body scrolls when block space is constrained.

The two actions are tracked as one group under every pointer, the way iOS tracks the actions of an alert: the action under the pointer highlights as soon as it is pressed, the highlight follows the pointer from one action to the other, and the release runs the action under it. Releasing off both actions runs nothing. The keyboard and assistive technology keep the click of each button.

For cases where you want to show an alert without managing open state, use the `useImperativeAlertDialog` hook: call `alert.show(options)` and render `alert.element` in your tree.

name:        Dialog
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Dialog
description: Dialog displays a modal overlay that blocks interaction with the page until the user responds. Use it for delete confirmations, edit forms, terms acceptance, or any decision that should not be skipped.

name:        DialogHeader
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Dialog
description: 使用 DialogHeader 为对话框提供带标签的标题区和可选的关闭控件。

Divider

name:        Divider
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Divider
description: A visual separator that divides content into distinct sections. Use to create clear boundaries between groups of related content, or to demarcate interactive regions within a layout.

Drawer

name:        Drawer
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Drawer
description: 浮在页面内容之上的侧边面板，用于检查器和详情视图--"点击表格行查看详情"的模式。与停靠面板不同，它覆盖在布局之上，不会挤压页面。桌面端按 width 设定宽度，宽度小于 640px 时保留 56px 的底层页面，并且不超过 width 上限。按 Escape 关闭抽屉（purpose 为 required 时除外），焦点返回到打开它的元素。滑入/滑出动画遵循 prefers-reduced-motion。堆叠约定：同级抽屉后开的在上层，Escape 只关闭最上层的，关闭顺序由内向外--请以同级方式渲染，切勿嵌套。

与 Dialog 一样，Drawer 是一个容器：内容区域默认带有 --spacing-4（16px）的内边距，也可以由 padding 属性或主题中 drawer 的 padding 设置。像 Dialog 一样用 Layout 组合页眉、正文和页脚：DrawerHeader 放在 header 插槽（传入 onOpenChange 时显示关闭按钮，与 DialogHeader 相同），正文放在 LayoutContent，操作放在 LayoutFooter。Layout 会把内边距分配给这些区域，使它们对齐在同一条内容线上，页眉也不会被重复缩进。作为唯一子元素的 Section 同样会越出该内边距。Drawer 本身不渲染关闭按钮，所以每个抽屉都要提供可见的关闭方式，非模态抽屉尤其如此，因为它没有可点击的遮罩。在打开时应获得焦点的控件上加 data-autofocus。

如何选择：居中的决定或短表单用 Dialog；保持页面可见的全高侧边详情用 Drawer；触屏上的块轴面板用 BottomSheet；内容应当把页面挤开重排时用停靠面板（布局分栏），而不是浮层。

主题化：面板是唯一的稳定目标（astryx-drawer，data-side 反映 side 值），遮罩是面板的原生 ::backdrop。DrawerHeader 为其标题行、插槽和关闭图标提供 astryx-drawer-header 系列目标。

name:        DrawerHeader
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Drawer
description: 像 Dialog 中的 DialogHeader 一样，把 DrawerHeader 放在 Drawer 内 Layout 的 header 插槽，提供标题行；传入 onOpenChange 时显示关闭按钮。Layout 让页眉对齐抽屉的内边距，而不是重复缩进。Drawer 本身不渲染关闭按钮。与 DialogHeader 不同，它不会在打开时获得焦点（Drawer 使用 data-autofocus），也不为抽屉命名（由 Drawer 的 label 命名）。

DropdownMenu

name:        DropdownMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: A dropdown menu that displays a list of actionable items in a popup triggered by a button. Use to present action options as a next step in a process, or to offer contextual actions without cluttering the interface.

name:        DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: 可勾选的菜单项（role="menuitemcheckbox"），用于切换独立的布尔值。用于 DropdownMenu 中的开关选项；单选请使用 DropdownMenuRadioGroup。

name:        DropdownMenuDivider
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "divider"}` entry in `items`; both modes render this component, so they look and theme identically. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the separator; its role and orientation stay component-owned.

name:        DropdownMenuGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: 使用 DropdownMenuGroup 为相关的复合菜单行提供同一个可见名称和无障碍名称。只有当名称能帮助理解这些菜单行时才使用分组。

name:        DropdownMenuItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: Use DropdownMenuItem inside DropdownMenu compound mode for one action or destination. Keep label, description, icon, and endContent non-interactive; controls belong in separate rows or the menu header/footer.

name:        DropdownMenuRadioGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: DropdownMenu 中由调用方控制且有名称的单选组（menuitemradio 的 role="group"）。该组负责值传递、关闭策略、根元素组合和菜单项间距；父 DropdownMenu 负责键盘导航。

name:        DropdownMenuRadioItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: DropdownMenuRadioGroup 中的单个选项（role="menuitemradio"）。必须在 DropdownMenuRadioGroup 内使用。

name:        DropdownMenuSubMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items. The row adopts DropdownMenuItem semantics (label / icon / description / isDisabled); its children become the flyout content. Opens inline-end with viewport auto-flip; Right/Enter/Space opens and focuses the first item, Left/Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (Right/Left swap in RTL). On a phone (a coarse pointer, decided when the menu opened) the row drills in instead: its rows replace the menu's rows in the same box, led by a Back row named "Back to <parent>", and Back, Escape or ArrowLeft return to the row. Host attributes and DOM event handlers (aria-*, data-*, id) reach the trigger row, the element carrying role="menuitem" and aria-haspopup="menu"; a caller's handlers run after the row's own, except for the keys that open the flyout (the open arrow, Enter, Space) and a click on a disabled row. For data-driven menus, give a menu item a nested `items` array instead of using this component directly.

EmptyState

name:        EmptyState
import:      @astryxdesign/core/EmptyState
description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data. Use it for empty lists, zero search results, first-time setups, or cleared inboxes. Always include a title and a next step so the user is not stuck.

Field

name:        Field
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Field
description: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI. Use it when you need the Field shell around a control you own; use styled Astryx inputs like TextInput, Typeahead, and Select directly when they already expose label, description, and validation props.

name:        FieldLabel
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Field
description: 独立标签组，可标记单个控件或调用方命名的控件组，并支持说明文本、可选/必填指示器、图标和工具提示。

name:        FieldStatus
import:      @astryxdesign/core/FieldStatus
description: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls. Use it directly for custom controls that need the same error, warning, or success presentation as Field.

name:        InputGroup
import:      @astryxdesign/core/InputGroup
description: InputGroup connects an input with prefix/suffix addons in a single visual unit. Use it for URL fields, currency inputs, search fields with action buttons, or any input that needs contextual decorations.

name:        InputGroupText
import:      @astryxdesign/core/InputGroup
description: Use InputGroupText inside InputGroup for a short fixed prefix or suffix, such as a currency symbol, a protocol, or a unit, or for a decorative icon. It is plain text, not a control, and it is not part of the input's accessible name.

FileInput

name:        FileInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/FileInput
description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support. Use it for single or multiple file selection with built-in validation for file type, size, and count. Pair with validation status for upload feedback.

Heading

name:        Heading
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Heading
description: 语义化标题组件，渲染带主题样式的 h1-h6 元素，支持可选的编辑风格比例和行截断。

HoverCard

name:        HoverCard
import:      @astryxdesign/core/HoverCard
description: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element. Use it for profile cards, link summaries, or inline definitions where the user needs more context without navigating away.

Icon

name:        Icon
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Icon
description: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts. They improve scannability and reinforce meaning alongside text. Supports both direct SVG components and semantic icon names that adapt to the active theme.

InfoTip

name:        InfoTip
import:      @astryxdesign/core/InfoTip
description: An info icon that reveals help: a small "i" button. Hover and keyboard focus preview the help, and a click, tap, Enter, or Space pins it open until Escape, a second press, a press outside, or focus leaving. Use it next to labels, values, and metrics for permission notes, metric definitions, and field help.

Item

name:        Item
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Item
description: 通用项目原语，统一 Astryx 中 "起始内容 + 标签 + 描述 + 结束内容" 的布局模式。适用于下拉菜单、选择器、联系人列表、通知、文件浏览器和活动流等场景。

Kbd

name:        Kbd
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Kbd
description: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges. Use Kbd in tooltips, menus, and help text to show key combinations.

Layout

name:        Center
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Center
description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container. Use it for empty states, loading screens, login forms, or any content that should sit in the center of the available space.

name:        FormLayout
import:      @astryxdesign/core/FormLayout
description: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction. FormLayout handles where fields go, not state or submission. Wrap it in a native <form> for that; <form> has no Astryx replacement, so it stays a plain element. Supports vertical (default), horizontal, and horizontal-labels directions, and can be nested to mix them.

name:        Grid
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Grid
description: A CSS grid layout container for arranging children in rows and columns. Use Grid for card galleries, dashboards, and any multi-column layout. For columns that reflow on small screens, use `columns={{minWidth, max}}`; a numeric `columns` is exactly N columns at every width and never reflows.

name:        GridSpan
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Grid
description: 可跨越多列或多行的网格项。

name:        HStack
import:      @astryxdesign/core/HStack
description: 水平堆叠组件，沿行内方向排列元素：LTR 中从左到右，RTL 中从右到左。支持多态渲染。

name:        Layout
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layout
description: Layout is a general five-slot primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions within a page or bounded container. AppShell owns the page shell and app-wide navigation behavior; use HStack or VStack for simple directional stacking.

name:        LayoutContent
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layout
description: 可滚动的主内容区域。

name:        LayoutFooter
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layout
description: 用于操作栏、分页和状态栏的底部栏。

name:        LayoutHeader
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layout
description: 用于页面标题、应用栏和工具栏的顶部栏。

name:        LayoutPanel
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Layout
description: 用于导航、设置或检查器面板的侧边栏。

name:        Section
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Section
description: Section is the correct way to create page regions and group related content on a page. Use it for settings groups, form sections, sidebar areas, or any time you need visual separation between parts of a page. If you are tempted to use a Card for a page section, use Section instead.

name:        Stack
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Stack
description: Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

name:        VStack
import:      @astryxdesign/core/VStack
description: 垂直堆叠组件，将元素从上到下排列。支持多态渲染。

Lightbox

name:        Lightbox
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Lightbox
description: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution. Supports single-item and gallery modes with prev/next navigation and swiping, optional zoom and pan for images, and native video controls.

Link

name:        Link
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Link
description: A styled anchor for inline and standalone text navigation. Supports external links, underline variants, tooltips, and custom link components for router integration. Use it for navigating between pages or to external URLs.

List

name:        List
import:      @astryxdesign/core/List
description: A vertical collection of items with consistent spacing, dividers, and optional markers. Supports headers, icons, avatars, badges, and interactive items with click or link behavior. Use it to display ordered or unordered groups of related content.

name:        ListItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/List
description: 列表项，包含标签、描述、起始/结束内容插槽和交互模式。

Markdown

name:        Markdown
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Markdown
description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

MetadataList

name:        MetadataList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MetadataList
description: MetadataList displays key-value pairs for object attributes like quality, condition, and status, in a structured layout. Use it for detail panels, settings summaries, and record information.

name:        MetadataListItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MetadataList
description: MetadataList 中的单个带标签元数据值。

MoreMenu

name:        MoreMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MoreMenu
description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars.

Navigation

name:        MobileNav
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MobileNav
description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. MobileNav is the mobile counterpart to SideNav and accepts the same children. Use it on narrow viewports where a persistent sidebar is not practical.

name:        NavIcon
import:      @astryxdesign/core/NavIcon
description: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading and PageNavHeader to visually identify a section or application.

name:        SideNav
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SideNav
description: A sidebar navigation component for organizing application pages with sections, nested items, and icons. Use SideNav as the primary navigation when an app has 5 or more destinations or requires hierarchical grouping.

name:        SideNavCollapseButton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SideNav
description: 侧边栏折叠切换按钮。放置在 SideNav 内部（自动读取上下文）或外部（向两者传入同一个受控 collapsible 配置）。默认渲染为仅图标的 ghost 按钮。

name:        SideNavHeading
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SideNav
description: 产品/套件/账户头部，具有智能交互边界逻辑，支持链接和菜单弹出框。

name:        SideNavItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SideNav
description: 导航项，支持图标、选中状态、可选尾部内容，以及通过 children 实现嵌套。

name:        SideNavSection
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SideNav
description: 分组，支持可选的标题、副标题和尾部内容。

name:        TopNav
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: TopNav is a horizontal navigation bar for product-level navigation in application headers. Use TopNav for 5 or fewer always-visible navigation items, or minimal navigation paired with search and controls. For complex navigation hierarchies, use a sidebar; to filter content, use tabs or filter buttons instead.

name:        TopNavHeading
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: TopNav 标题插槽的产品/套件/账户标题组件。支持智能交互边界逻辑：标志、标题文本、独立链接的上标题/下标题，以及带自动箭头指示器的可选菜单弹出层。

name:        TopNavItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: 用于 TopNav startContent 的导航链接项，渲染为具有悬停和选中状态的锚点。

name:        TopNavMegaMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: 导航项，在悬停时显示全宽超级菜单面板。使用插槽 API（items 和 featured）。TopNavMegaMenuItem 在桌面和移动抽屉模式中自行渲染。

name:        TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: 超级菜单 featured 插槽的标准特色卡片。提供带可选图片、标题、描述和 CTA 链接的一致卡片。

name:        TopNavMegaMenuItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: 超级菜单中的单个项目。在桌面端（弹出层网格）和移动抽屉模式中都会自行渲染。

name:        TopNavMenu
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TopNav
description: 导航项，在悬停时显示弹出菜单，包含带图标、标题和可选描述的丰富菜单项。

NumberInput

name:        NumberInput
import:      @astryxdesign/core/NumberInput
description: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls. Use NumberInput for quantities, measurements, percentages, and similar inputs.

Outline

name:        Outline
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Outline
description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes.

OverflowList

name:        OverflowList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/OverflowList
description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.

Overlay

name:        Overlay
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Overlay
description: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the root element.

Pagination

name:        Pagination
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Pagination
description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results. Pick a variant to match the context: numbered pages for data tables, a count for large lists, compact for tight spaces, or dots for carousels.

Popover

name:        Popover
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Popover
description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. Use it for secondary actions, inline confirmations, or supplementary information that does not warrant a full dialog. For hover previews use HoverCard, for brief helper text use Tooltip. Under a finger (a coarse primary pointer), it is presented like a native popover: it grows out of its trigger and shrinks back into it on the theme's motion tokens; with reduced motion it cross-fades, opacity only, in 200 ms or less.

PowerSearch

name:        PowerSearch
import:      @astryxdesign/core/PowerSearch
description: PowerSearch is a structured filter bar where each token represents a field, operator, and value. Use it for complex multi-dimensional filtering when users need to combine multiple search criteria. For simple single-field search, use a text input instead.

ProgressBar

name:        ProgressBar
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ProgressBar
description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. Supports semantic color variants, value labels, and custom formatting. Under a finger a new value animates as on iOS: linearly, in proportion to how far it moves (a full track takes one second at the theme's default tempo), and the fill keeps a minimum visible length above zero.

Radio

name:        RadioList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/RadioList
description: A group of options where only one can be selected at a time. All options are visible at once, making it easy to compare choices. Use it when users need to pick one option from a small set.

name:        RadioListItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/RadioList
description: 单个单选选项，包含标签、描述和内容插槽。在粗指针（触摸）下，已启用选项的目标通过不可见的点击区域向 44 px 扩展。它不小于所在行，与相邻控件较近时止于间距的一半；行尺寸不变。该点击区域是行的 `::after`，因此请用子元素装饰行。

ScrollableArea

name:        ScrollableArea
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ScrollableArea
description: Provides a native scroll viewport and a real observed content box. The viewport enters the tab order only while a requested logical axis is effectively scrollable, and containment applies only to effective axes.

SegmentedControl

name:        SegmentedControl
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SegmentedControl
description: A segmented button group that allows users to make a single selection from a small set of mutually exclusive options. Use SegmentedControl when all options should be visible at once and the selection controls a value or mode, not page navigation. Under a finger, on a touch device (a coarse primary pointer), the selection slides to the new segment, whether a tap, an arrow key or a new value moved it; with Reduce Motion nothing travels: the old selection fades out as the new one fades in. There, dragging the selected segment carries the selection along with the selected label's colour following it, and the segment under the finger is chosen when it lets go (letting go outside the control selects nothing); a tap selects through the browser's click; a pressed segment shows the shared pressed overlay, and nothing lifts or dims. With a mouse or a pen every change, a click included, slides on the theme's duration and easing, and dragging the selected segment carries it as a finger does.

name:        SegmentedControlItem
import:      @astryxdesign/core/SegmentedControl
description: 单个分段项，在分段控件中渲染为单选按钮。

Selector

name:        ComplexSelector
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ComplexSelector
description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. It is intentionally one component: ComplexSelector owns the field, trigger, popover, focus restore, and changeAction flow, while the content render prop owns the selector-specific accessible structure.

name:        MultiSelector
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MultiSelector
description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges. Use it for filtering or when presenting a finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.

name:        Selector
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Selector
description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states. Use it in forms and settings when presenting a moderate number of options. Keyboard typeahead matches a native select: typing on the focused closed trigger selects the matching option directly, repeated presses cycle through options sharing a first letter, and spaces count as match characters ("new y" reaches "New York"). With the menu open, typing moves the highlight and Enter commits. With hasSearch, typing on the closed trigger opens the popup and seeds the search input.

name:        SelectorOption
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Selector
description: 用于在 Selector 的 renderOption 渲染函数中自定义选项渲染的辅助组件。

Skeleton

name:        Skeleton
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Skeleton
description: An animated shimmer placeholder that previews the shape of content while it loads. Use it to build loading screens that match the layout of the real content. For content with unknown dimensions, use Spinner instead.

Slider

name:        Slider
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Slider
description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds. Supports single value and range selection, tick marks, custom value formatting, and vertical orientation. Use it when users need to explore a continuous range, such as volume, price, or percentage. Under a finger, on any touch device, it tracks as UISlider does: only the thumb takes a drag, through a target larger than it, the value follows the finger's travel rather than jumping to it, a release coasts on before `onChangeEnd`, a swipe from the track scrolls the page, and a tap on the track or a mark sets the value when the finger lifts (the thumb springs there). A mouse drag on a thumb tracks the same way, past the same 10 px in any direction, with no lift or coast; a mouse press on the track moves the thumb there, and only a primary click presses. A pen drags as a finger does, claiming only along the track, and its drag ends at the release with no coast. A wheel or a trackpad scroll over the slider goes to whatever scrolls under it.

Spinner

name:        Spinner
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Spinner
description: An animated loading indicator for processes with unknown duration, such as data fetching or form submission. Supports visible labels, multiple sizes, and a dark background variant. For content with known dimensions, use Skeleton instead.

StatusDot

name:        StatusDot
import:      @astryxdesign/core/StatusDot
description: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels. Supports five semantic variants and an optional pulse animation. Always pair with a visible text label, as color alone should not carry meaning.

Stepper

name:        Step
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Stepper
description: Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description. Progress (completed/active/not-started) is derived from the parent Stepper's activeStep and this step's step index.

name:        Stepper
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Stepper
description: 步骤器显示通过一系列逻辑编号步骤的进度。用于多步骤工作流程，如表单、入职流程或结账流程。

Switch

name:        Switch
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Switch
description: A toggle control for on/off states that take effect immediately. Supports labels, descriptions, loading states, and validation. Use it for settings or preferences that apply instantly. For changes requiring a form submission, use a checkbox instead. Under a finger it moves like the iOS switch on every touch screen: a press lifts the thumb, a drag across flips it, lifting the finger commits, and a tap toggles through the browser's click. The thumb keeps its circle and size on every device, and under a coarse pointer the invisible hit area grows toward 44 × 44 px, stopping halfway to any neighbouring control so a tap goes to the nearer one. With reduced motion on, a change cross-fades on a touch screen and is immediate with a mouse.

Table

name:        Table
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: Table displays structured data in rows and columns with consistent dimensionality. It supports rich cell content, sorting, selection, pagination, and column management through a composable plugin system. Use Table for data sets with uniform structure; for simpler or inconsistent data, consider a list or card layout instead.

name:        TableBody
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <tbody> wrapper for children mode. Holds the data rows. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so rows written straight into Table mismatch on hydration. The data-driven data={...} mode renders this element itself; in children mode it is yours to supply.

name:        TableCell
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <td> 包装器，读取 TableContext 以在 Table 内部使用时应用密度内边距、字体大小和分隔线边框。

name:        TableFooter
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <tfoot> wrapper for children mode. Holds summary or total rows beneath the body. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. Children mode only: the data-driven data={...} path renders a header and a body, never a footer.

name:        TableHeader
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <thead> wrapper for children mode. Holds the header row, whose cells are TableHeaderCell. A row must sit inside a section: <table> cannot contain a <tr> directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied <tbody> when it parses server-rendered markup and React does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. The data-driven data={...} mode renders this element itself whenever columns are supplied; in children mode it is yours to supply.

name:        TableHeaderCell
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <th> 包装器，读取 TableContext 以在 Table 内部使用时应用密度内边距、半粗字重、次要文本颜色和分隔线边框。

name:        TableRow
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: <tr> 包装器，读取 TableContext 以在 Table 内部使用时应用条纹、悬停和分隔线样式。

name:        TableSelectionToolbar
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Table
description: Pass both outputs of useTableSelectionState to their matching consumers: selectionConfig to useTableSelection and selectionState to TableSelectionToolbar. Render product actions through startContent. Keep fixed or floating placement in the surrounding layout.

name:        Tab
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TabList
description: 单个标签项，渲染为按钮或锚点链接，具有选中状态样式和可选图标。

name:        TabList
import:      @astryxdesign/core/TabList

Timestamp

Toast

name:        Toast
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Toast
description: Toast 显示简短的非阻塞通知，用于确认操作或呈现临时信息。适用于用户需要反馈但不需要做决定的场景，如保存、删除或状态变更。

生产环境中推荐使用 `useToast()` hook，它通过 `ToastViewport` 处理定位、堆叠、自动关闭和去重。Toast 会保持在视口和安全区域边距内，较长的消息会换行，并根据配置的顶部或底部边缘进入、退出或滑动关闭。垂直滑动与位置动效使用同一空间模型：顶部 Toast 向上离开，底部 Toast 向下离开。只有在动作明确朝向关闭边缘时才会接管原生触摸移动，滑动关闭继续报告现有的 manual 原因。触控笔属于直接接触输入，因此支持相同手势；鼠标拖动会与桌面文本选择冲突，所以不启用，关闭按钮始终可用。当操作或消息必须持续可用时，请显式设置 `isAutoHide: false`。`Toast` 组件以内联方式渲染 toast 视觉元素，适用于不需要视口生命周期的预览、文档和静态展示。

description: Token is a small, inline element for representing discrete pieces of associated data, like tags, categories, or selections. Use it to label content, show active filters, or represent removable items like selected recipients in a compose field.

Tooltip

description: Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown. It renders no input wrapper, border, or selected-value token. Typeahead and Tokenizer compose it for standard fields.

name:        Typeahead

description: A searchable input for selecting a single item from a large or dynamic dataset. Results appear as the user types, with support for async data sources, debounced search, and custom item rendering. Use it when the option list is too large for a Selector dropdown.

name:        TypeaheadItem

Utilities

name:        InternationalizationProvider
import:      @astryxdesign/core/i18n
description: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.

name:        LinkProvider
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Link
description: Wraps your app to replace the default <a> tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Next.js Link) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.

name:        MediaTheme
import:      @astryxdesign/core/theme
description: Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips. The base behavior flips color-scheme so all light-dark() tokens resolve to the correct side. Only a small set of tokens need explicit overrides beyond that. Themes can further customize component appearance on media surfaces via onDark/onLight in defineTheme(), with both token overrides (e.g. "--color-accent": "#90CAF9") and component overrides (e.g. ghost buttons get a border on dark surfaces).

name:        Theme
import:      @astryxdesign/core/theme
description: Wraps a subtree with a specific Astryx theme. For static production themes, use `astryx theme build` and import the generated CSS plus built theme object for first-paint and SSR performance. Use runtime `defineTheme()` when themes are dynamic or for prototyping.

`defineTheme` accepts a `tokens` object whose keys are CSS custom property names (always prefixed with `--`). Common token names include `--color-accent`, `--color-background-surface`, `--color-background-body`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-text-secondary`, `--radius-container`, `--spacing-1` through `--spacing-6`. Values can be a string (same for light/dark) or a `[light, dark]` tuple.

Example:
```ts
import {defineTheme} from '@astryxdesign/core/theme';
const myTheme = defineTheme({
  name: 'ocean',
  tokens: {
    '--color-accent': ['#0077B6', '#48CAE4'],
    '--color-background-surface': ['#F0F8FF', '#0A1628'],
    '--color-text-primary': ['#0A1317', '#FFFFFF'],
    '--radius-container': '16px',
  },
});
```
